notes: The pinned C++ binding exposes mandatory transportation types through TransportationTypeHandle and getTransportationTypeHandle(name), not public RTI_RELIABLE/RTI_BEST_EFFORT enum tokens. The standard-order-and-transportation-lookups scenario checks that HLAreliable and HLAbestEffort resolve to valid, distinct handles, that handles are stable between joined federates, and that getTransportationTypeName round-trips both standard names. This is direct public C++ API evidence for the two standard type availability requirements; it does not test their message-delivery classifications, independent-provider interoperability, or conformance.
